Name: Right click to untill soil
Author: kumagabear
Description:
When you use hoe you can right click to untill soil, it doesn't decrease the stamina
Currently you can only untill 1 soil, I still haven't figure it out how to make it like hold/power tools

I quite like the Sun Haven right click to untill soil so I tried to make this in stardew

[b]Configuration
[/b]Use Tool Location - if you use gamepad/keyboard you can use the action button to untill, it will disable mouse mode
Tool Radius - Maximum to untill the soil, if you want use like other tools set it to 1
Tool Speed - Tool speed animation
